subject.title: fix: before_agent_run transform no longer leaks redacted text into history

question: Should `before_agent_run` permanently expose a public `transform` outcome that rewrites the canonical stored user turn rather than only model-bound input?
rationale: The branch changes both a public plugin API and durable session-history semantics; code review cannot choose whether transcript fidelity or persistent redaction is the intended product guarantee.

options.title: Canonical redaction
options.body: Approve `transform` as a public outcome whose replacement becomes the canonical current user turn after ownership and compatibility proof are fixed.

options.title: Model-bound transform only
options.body: Keep stored user text unchanged and require durable-redaction plugins to block or use a separately designed transcript-mutation API.

options.title: Narrow private seam
options.body: Defer the general public outcome and first design an identity-bound redaction contract with explicit audit and display semantics.

recommendation.title: Canonical redaction
recommendation.body: Approve `transform` as a public outcome whose replacement becomes the canonical current user turn after ownership and compatibility proof are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the closest available CLI transcript identity and persistence invariants.
